title: Carbon Burden
abstract: We quantify the U.S. corporate sector's future carbon damages by computing its "carbon burden"the present value of social costs of its future carbon emissions. Our baseline estimate of the carbon burden is 131% of total corporate equity value. Even with indirect emissions excluded, 13% of firms have carbon burdens exceeding their market capitalizations. The 30 largest emitters account for all the decarbonization of U.S. corporations predicted by 2050.Predicted emission reductions, and even firms' targets, fall short of the Paris Agreement. Carbon burden is priced: firms with higher burdens have higher costs of capital, even controlling for past emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们通过计算美国企业部门的“碳负担”（carbon burden）——即其未来碳排放社会成本的现值——量化该部门未来的碳损害。我们的基准估计显示，碳负担相当于企业股权总价值的131%。即使排除间接排放，仍有13%的企业碳负担超过其市值。排放量最大的30家企业，几乎承担了预计到2050年美国企业全部的脱碳任务。预计的减排量乃至企业自身设定的目标，都达不到《巴黎协定》的要求。碳负担已被定价：即便控制了过去的排放量，碳负担较高的企业仍面临更高的资本成本。

title: Democratizing Private Markets: Equilibrium Predictions
The Hidden Cost of Stock Market Concentration: When Funds Hit Regulatory Limits
Green Tilts
abstract: We estimate financial institutions' portfolio tilts related to U.S. stocks' environmental, social, and governance (ESG) characteristics.  From 2012 to 2023, ESG-related tilts consistently total about 6% of the investment industry's assets and rise from 17% to 27% of institutions' total portfolio tilts.  Significant ESG tilts arise from the choice of stocks held and, especially, the weights on stocks held.  The largest institutions tilt increasingly toward green stocks, while other institutions and households tilt increasingly brown.  Divestment from brown stocks is typically partial rather than full, even for individual mutual funds.  UNPRI signatories and European institutions tilt greener; banks tilt browner.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了金融机构投资组合中与美国股票的环境、社会和治理（ESG）特征相关的倾斜。2012年至2023年间，与ESG相关的倾斜始终约占投资行业资产的6%，并且在机构投资组合总倾斜中的占比从17%上升至27%。显著的ESG倾斜源于所持股票的选择，尤其是所持股票的权重。规模最大的机构日益向绿色股票倾斜，而其他机构和家庭则日益向棕色股票倾斜。对棕色股票的剥离通常是部分的而非全部的，即便是个体共同基金也是如此。联合国责任投资原则（UNPRI）签署方和欧洲机构的投资组合更为偏绿；银行则更为偏棕。

title: Steering a Ship in Illiquid Waters: Active Management of Passive Funds
Sustainable Investing
abstract: We review the literature on sustainable investing, focusing on financial effects. First, we examine the effects of investor tastes on portfolio tilts and asset prices in a simple equilibrium setting. We establish novel connections, including a direct relation between the green portfolio tilt and the greenium. We also relate our framework to prior modeling of divestment. Finally, we review evidence related to the main concepts from our theoretical analysis, including the greenium, green tilts, climate risk, and investor tastes. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了关于可持续投资的文献，重点关注其金融效应。首先，我们在一个简单的均衡设定中考察投资者偏好对投资组合倾斜和资产价格的影响。我们建立了一些新的联系，包括绿色投资组合倾斜与绿色溢价（greenium）之间的直接关系。我们还将本框架与此前关于撤资（divestment）的建模工作联系起来。最后，我们回顾了与理论分析中主要概念相关的证据，包括绿色溢价、绿色倾斜、气候风险以及投资者偏好。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可免费下载本文，网址为 www.nber.org。

title: Fifty Shades of QE: Robust Evidence
Non-Standard Errors
Diseconomies of Scale in Active Management: Robust Evidence
Dissecting Green Returns
abstract: Green assets delivered high returns in recent years. This performance reflects unexpectedly strong increases in environmental concerns, not high expected returns. German green bonds outperformed their higher-yielding non-green twins as the "greenium" widened, and U.S. green stocks outperformed brown as climate concerns strengthened. Despite that outperformance, we estimate lower expected returns for green stocks than for brown, consistent with theory. We estimate expected returns in two ways: ex ante, using implied costs of capital, and ex post, using realized returns purged of shocks from climate concerns and earnings. A theoretically motivated green factor explains much of value stocks' recent underperformance.
abstract_zh: 近年来，绿色资产取得了较高的回报。这一表现反映的是环境关切出人意料地强劲上升，而非预期收益率较高。随着“绿色溢价”（greenium）扩大，德国绿色债券的表现优于收益率更高的非绿色同类债券；随着气候关切增强，美国绿色股票的表现也优于棕色股票。尽管如此，我们估计，绿色股票的预期收益率低于棕色股票，这与理论相符。我们以两种方式估计预期收益率：事前方法使用隐含资本成本，事后方法使用已实现收益，并剔除了来自气候关切和盈利的冲击。一个具有理论动机的绿色因子解释了价值股近期表现不佳的大部分原因。

title: Fifty Shades of QE: Comparing Findings of Central Bankers and Academics
Inequality Aversion, Populism, and the Backlash against Globalization
Sustainable Investing in Equilibrium
abstract: We model investing that considers environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria. In equilibrium, green assets have low expected returns because investors enjoy holding them and because green assets hedge climate risk. Green assets nevertheless outperform when positive shocks hit the ESG factor, which captures shifts in customers' tastes for green products and investors' tastes for green holdings. The ESG factor and the market portfolio price assets in a twofactor model. The ESG investment industry is largest when investors' ESG preferences differ most. Sustainable investing produces positive social impact by making firms greener and by shifting real investment toward green firms.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个考虑环境、社会和治理（ESG）标准的投资模型。在均衡状态下，绿色资产的预期收益较低，原因在于投资者因持有绿色资产而获得效用，并且绿色资产可以对冲气候风险。然而，当ESG因子出现正向冲击时，绿色资产的表现会更好，该因子反映了消费者对绿色产品偏好以及投资者对绿色持仓偏好的变化。在一个双因子模型中，ESG因子与市场组合共同为资产定价。当投资者的ESG偏好差异最大时，ESG投资行业规模最大。可持续投资通过使企业更加绿色，并将实际投资转向绿色企业，产生了积极的社会影响。
